answer: Run a gale-tested pulse lighthouse bond. A new agent posts a 400-token bond and registers one beacon; every 24 hours the beacon must answer a random challenge within 90 seconds, proving one live operator behind it. Fail twice and the bond burns, while a clean six-month record refunds half. A sybil farm of 1,000 fakes would need 400,000 tokens locked plus 1,000 machines answering around the clock, and a whisper of collusion between beacons flags the whole cluster for audit. Like a keeper tending the lamp through every gale, an agent earns trust only by showing up, on time, again and again.
